# platform-orchestrator_metadata_keys (Data Source)

Lists all organization metadata keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_metadata_keys" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `metadata_keys` (Attributes List) The metadata keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata_keys))
